name: project-adoption
title: Bind adoption to the project-root agent rule entry
interface: CLI: node tools/adopt.mjs <project-root> [--graph <relative-dir>] [--apply | --check]. Default is read-only preview. Apply merges a single managed protocol block into root AGENTS.md and existing CLAUDE.md, preserves unrelated rules, installs a checked root-entry law and receipt, and rejects scope escapes/conflicts before writes. Check fails on drift. Init binds new project roots automatically.
nl_description: Cloning alone is not adoption. Whole-project frontier/submission/verify discipline must be discoverable at the actual root, continuously checked, and preserve local permissions/human approvals.
